settings.hero_desc: A fully illuminated scale model of a beachfront residential development, complete with furnished interiors, a rooftop infinity pool, sculpted entrance canopy and a diorama base with corniche road, beach and sea. Built for sales galleries and investor presentations.
settings.perso_placeholder: Project name, scale and base size
settings.s1_body: Commissioned for a beachfront residential project, this sales gallery model recreates the entire development in miniature - from the flowing travertine balconies and glass facades to the rooftop infinity pool, landscaped drop-off and sculpted entrance canopy. Every apartment glows with warm LED light, revealing fully furnished interiors, while the diorama base extends the story with a corniche road, cycle track, palm-lined promenade, sandy beach and sea. A model like this becomes the centrepiece of any sales gallery, helping buyers and investors see the finished project long before handover.
settings.case_heading: The Centrepiece of the Sales Gallery
settings.case_body: Delivered and installed for an urban planning consultancy in Fujairah (DRU), the model now anchors the gallery experience - buyers walk around the building, look into lit apartments and instantly understand the beachfront setting, the amenities and the views they are buying into.
settings.case_quote: The model completely changed our sales conversations. Everyone in the office liked it.
settings.prov_p: Renders show a project; a physical model makes people believe in it. An illuminated scale model turns floor plans and brochures into something buyers can walk around, point at and remember.
